themes: Patience of the Prophet (peace be upon him)
summary_for_children: At-Tur means The Mount. It swears by the mount, a written book and the raised heaven, and tells the Prophet (peace be upon him) to be patient and glorify Allah.
world_title: The Mount and the Raised Heaven
environment_concept: A lone mountain (52:1), an open scroll on a stone (52:3) and a high sky (52:5).
architecture_and_scenery: A lone mountain, an open scroll on a stone, a distant house, a high sky and a glowing sea.

areas.name: Parchment Spread Open
areas.description: An open scroll on a stone; text is the ayah itself.

activities.name: Oaths path
activities.description: Lay six numbered stones in order, one for each of the first six ayahs.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

story_library.source: Owner's 'Quran Adventure — Children's Story Library' (2026-11-04), first-draft narration for ages about 7-12
story_library.title: The Mountain
story_library.children_narration: A mountain can remind us of the greatness of the natural world. Surah At-Tur asks people to think seriously about creation, truth, and the life to come. It encourages reflection on where we came from and why our choices matter.

world_idea.title: The Mountain of Reflection
world_idea.description: Climb safe trails, explore different rock formations, and reach observation points where children discover questions and lessons from the surah.

story_library.checks: Every reference exists in the verified text (checked 2026-11-04). Narration is draft, written by the owner, not reviewed by a scholar.
